title: serialize-tenant-migration-order-and-robust-helm-hook-backoff
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: upgrades for tenant-configured Private installs can race during cluster-wide init and migration steps which caused inconsistent schema states in recent staged upgrades; this PR introduces a serialized tenant migration ordering and a resilient helm hook backoff/retry pattern to reduce upgrade flakiness across air-gapped and multi-tenant on-prem installs. Changes in this PR: 1) New values schema knobs under .values.private.init.migration: 'orderingStrategy' (serial|parallel), 'perTenantBackoff' (base,sleepFactor,maxRetries), and 'dryRunFirst' boolean to allow cluster operators to validate ordering without committing DB migrations; 2) Templated migration controller Deployment that reads the values and exposes a leader-election + ordered-queue mode that runs tenant migrations in a deterministic sequence; 3) Helm hook helper partials and a reusable 'hook-backoff' template which adds init-job annotations and a post-delete retry window; 4) Network preflight job template (network-setup-init) that runs on nodes with configured nodeAffinity/tolerations and exposes explicit failure reasons (DNS, kubelet rw access) to improve operator diagnostics; 5) Helm tests and smoke script for staged upgrade and rollback, plus documentation updates for upgrade playbook. Usage notes: default preserves current parallel behavior; set orderingStrategy=serial and dryRunFirst=true to validate; perTenantBackoff defaults are conservative (base=2s,factor=2,max=5). Migration: upgrade path is backward compatible; the serialized controller falls back to parallel mode when older values are present. Checklist: - [x] values schema docs and examples - [x] unit tests for template helpers - [x] integration smoke test for serial migrations - [x] upgrade notes and rollback guidance - [x] chart lint and helm test run. Related: ENG-4821 (migration stability), SUP-2198 (customer upgrade incident).

release_notes: Helm chart: added configurable tenant migration ordering (serial|parallel), per-tenant backoff and retry knobs, reusable helm hook backoff template, network preflight init job, and helm tests for staged upgrade/rollback. Backwards compatible by default; operators should read README-upgrades for enabling serial migrations and dry-run guidance.
additional_context: This PR targets reducing customer upgrade incidence rates observed during ENG-4821 and complements existing hook sequencing work. Ops teams should run helm test --cleanup in a staging environment with dryRunFirst=true before enabling serial ordering in production. For Private on-prem installs with strict network policies, ensure network-setup-init tolerations and nodeAffinity match your cluster profile.
